summary.headline: Mutation of Times by Heavy Planets
summary.text: Chapter VI explains seasonal weather changes caused by the heavy planets in hot, cold, and aquatic signs, including heat, cold, rain, dew, air tempering, dryness, and sterility. It identifies Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and the Sun as heavy planets and interprets their regional proximity, northern or southern position, oriental or occidental status, and rising.
